crossRefs.note: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him.
For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also…
When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer…

translations.web: If someone is found slain in the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,
translations.bsb: If one is found slain, lying in a field in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who killed him,
translations.kjv: If one be found slain in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it, lying in the field, and it be not known who hath slain
translations.asv: If one be found slain in the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee to possess it, lying in the field, and it be not known who hath smitten him;
